templates.title: Orders on a day
templates.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM dbo.Orders WHERE OrderDate >= {{day}} AND OrderDate < {{day+1}}

templates.title: Top customers
templates.sql: SELECT TOP ({{limit}}) c.FullName AS customer, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM dbo.Orders AS o JOIN dbo.Customers AS c ON c.CustomerId = o.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FullName ORDER BY orders DESC, customer
